names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 februarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιοι Θαλάσσιος και Λιμναίος», with the rank words left off.
Read out of the Охридски пролог's third heading for 22. фебруар ст. ст., „Преподобни Таласије и Лимније.“, which gives the two bare forenames under one rank word and no epithet for either.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 22 февраля ст. ст., «Лимний Сирийский, пустынник», with the rank word left off. The line on the day page gives the bare forename in the genitive with the company's epithet.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 февраля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Фалассия, Лимния и Варадата, пустынников Сирийских (V).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 februarie — «Sfântul Cuvios Limneu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιοι Θαλάσσιος και Λιμναίος»

attestations.note: One page for the two of them, which rests them on Theodoret of Cyrrhus and the Synaxarion of Constantinople. It gives no year for either and prints no hymn. Limnaeus is put on the mountain top near the city of Targala, thirty-eight years without a roof, and the page makes his shelters for the blind the greatest of his glories.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.03.2026 (22. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Таласије и Лимније.“

attestations.note: The Prologue's third heading names the two hermits together, so this row and `thalassius`'s quote the same line.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(V)» after the three names for 22 февраля ст. ст., and sets him in the same century as the Thalassius under whom it says he began.
